1.web: Wine is a mocker, and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
1.asv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; And whosoever erreth thereby is not wise.

2.web: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
2.asv: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own life.

3.web: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling.
3.asv: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; But every fool will be quarrelling.

4.web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
4.asv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; Therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

5.web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
5.asv: Counsel in the heart of man islikedeep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out.

6.web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
6.asv: Most men will proclaim every one his own kindness; But a faithful man who can find?

7.web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
7.asv: A righteous man that walketh in his integrity, Blessed are his children after him.

8.web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
8.asv: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

9.web: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
9.asv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

10.web: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
10.asv: Diverse weights, and diverse measures, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.

11.web: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
11.asv: Even a child maketh himself known by his doings, Whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

12.web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
12.asv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.

13.web: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
13.asv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; Open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

14.web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
14.asv: It is bad, it is bad, saith the buyer; But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

15.web: There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
15.asv: There is gold, and abundance of rubies; But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

16.web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
16.asv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge that is surety for foreigners.

17.web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
17.asv: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

18.web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
18.asv: Every purpose is established by counsel; And by wise guidance make thou war.

19.web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
19.asv: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; Therefore company not with him that openeth wide his lips.

20.web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
20.asv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, His lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

21.web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
21.asv: An inheritancemay be gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.

22.web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
22.asv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil: Wait for Jehovah, and he will save thee.

23.web: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
23.asv: Diverse weights are an abomination to Jehovah; And a false balance is not good.

24.web: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
24.asv: A man’s goings are of Jehovah; How then can man understand his way?

25.web: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
25.asv: It is a snare to a man rashly to say, It is holy, And after vows to make inquiry.

26.web: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
26.asv: A wise king winnoweth the wicked, And bringeth the threshing-wheel over them.

27.web: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
27.asv: The spirit of man is the lamp of Jehovah, Searching all his innermost parts.

28.web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
28.asv: Kindness and truth preserve the king; And his throne is upholden by kindness.

29.web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
29.asv: The glory of young men is their strength; And the beauty of old men is the hoary head.

30.web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
30.asv: Stripes that wound cleanse away evil; And strokesreachthe innermost parts.
